identity.source: huggingface.co pinned revision (x-linked-size == catalog; mirror hf-mirror.com same immutable path)

installed_truth_rules: a component is INSTALLED iff (a) the registry record state == INSTALLED AND (b) the recorded installedPath exists on disk with the catalog installedSizeBytes (read-back);
'Scaricato' (DOWNLOADED) means bytes in tmp verified complete — it is NOT installation and the UI may never present it as usable;
no code path may create an INSTALLED record without the bytes on disk (ensureRecord creates records WITHOUT installedPath only);
the runtime resolver binds ONLY to installed artifacts (CP-007).

registry_contract.ensureRecord(entry, state, note): UPSERT — creates the record from the catalog when absent (R1 repair of the silent markState no-op)
registry_contract.markInstalled(entry, path): the ONLY transition to INSTALLED, after the atomic promotion
registry_contract.readback: record survives restart (atomic JSON write: tmp + move)
